features.name: Caves
features.text: Morays, congers and lobsters need a cave.

features.name: Weed
features.text: Mullet and parrotfish graze on it.

features.name: Sand
features.text: Flatfish and bream like a sandy floor.

features.name: A freshwater spring
features.text: Brackish water at the pond's far end, for grey mullet and eels.

features.name: A shade roof
features.text: Keeps the water cool in summer; every fish grows a little faster.

features.name: A sea channel
features.text: Fresh sea water with every tide; fish grow faster.

features.name: Lucullus's tunnel
features.text: A tunnel cut through the rock to the open sea, as Lucullus had.
